# Citation

If you use Wilkins in your research, please cite the following paper:

> Yildiz, O., Morozov, D., Nigmetov, A., Nicolae, B., and Peterka, T. (2024). Wilkins: HPC in situ workflows made easy. *Frontiers in High Performance Computing*, 2, 1472719. doi: [10.3389/fhpcp.2024.1472719](https://doi.org/10.3389/fhpcp.2024.1472719)

## BibTeX

```bibtex
@article{yildiz2024wilkins,
  title     = {Wilkins: {HPC} in situ workflows made easy},
  author    = {Yildiz, Orcun and Morozov, Dmitriy and Nigmetov, Arnur and Nicolae, Bogdan and Peterka, Tom},
  journal   = {Frontiers in High Performance Computing},
  volume    = {2},
  pages     = {1472719},
  year      = {2024},
  publisher = {Frontiers},
  doi       = {10.3389/fhpcp.2024.1472719},
  url       = {https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/high-performance-computing/articles/10.3389/fhpcp.2024.1472719/full},
}
```

## Related software

- **LowFive** — HDF5 VOL plugin for in situ data transport: [github.com/diatomic/LowFive](https://github.com/diatomic/LowFive)
- **Henson** — Cooperative multitasking for HPC: [github.com/henson-insitu/henson](https://github.com/henson-insitu/henson)
